# Polys APP

> Polys is a platform connecting communities, sellers, and buyers in a collaborative marketplace ecosystem.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/): Landing page with platform overview
- [About](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/About): Company information and mission
- [Company News](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/CompanyNews): Latest news and updates
- [Privacy Terms](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/PrivacyTerms): Privacy policy and terms of service
- [Accessibility](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/Accessibility): Accessibility statement and features
- [Sustainability](https://poly-frontend-production.up.railway.app/Sustainability): Environmental and social initiatives

## Platform Features

- Community marketplace for local and regional commerce
- Seller dashboard for managing products and orders
- Project management tools for collaborative work
- Zone-based delivery and logistics management
- Financial reporting and audit tools for administrators

## Authentication

- Users must register and log in to access the full platform
- Multiple roles: buyer, seller, administrator
